mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO reservation_raw (svc_id, min_class, svc_stat, svc_name, pay_yn, place_name, use_target, svc_url, lng, lat, open_bgn, open_end, rcpt_bgn, rcpt_end, area_name, tel_no, v_min, v_max) VALUES
(#{r.svcId}, #{r.minClass}, #{r.svcStat}, #{r.svcName}, #{r.payYn}, #{r.placeName}, #{r.useTarget}, #{r.svcUrl}, #{r.lng}, #{r.lat}, #{r.openBgn}, #{r.openEnd}, #{r.rcptBgn}, #{r.rcptEnd}, #{r.areaName}, #{r.telNo}, #{r.vMin}, #{r.vMax})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE svc_stat = VALUES(svc_stat), svc_url = VALUES(svc_url), rcpt_end = VALUES(rcpt_end)
mapper.update: UPDATE facility_sports fs JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id JOIN (SELECT r.svc_url, r.place_name, r.lat, r.lng, CASE r.min_class WHEN '테니스장' THEN 6 WHEN '풋살장' THEN 8 WHEN '축구장' THEN 8 WHEN '농구장' THEN 7 WHEN '배드민턴장' THEN 4 WHEN '탁구장' THEN 5 WHEN '골프장' THEN 9 END AS sport_id FROM reservation_raw r WHERE r.svc_url LIKE 'http%' -- 원본이 '2026-08-19 23:59:00.0' 처럼 끝에 .0 이 붙어 온다. -- 그대로 변환하면 UPDATE 에서 오류가 나므로 앞 19자만 쓴다. AND STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(r.rcpt_end, 19), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= NOW()) m ON m.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND ( m.place_name = f.name OR ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(f.lng, f.lat), POINT(m.lng, m.lat)) <= 100 ) SET fs.reserve_url = m.svc_url
